evaluationScope: Current SearchOrchestrator.searchWithMetadata through a local in-memory controlled-fixture adapter. No calls to production routes, external providers, feeds, databases, or image services.

classificationDefinitions.REAL_OBSERVED: Outcome is directly evidenced by authorized real products/offers and frozen provenance. None available/used in this experiment.
classificationDefinitions.CONTROLLED_FIXTURE: A bounded synthetic corpus explicitly labeled as test fixture data exercises the existing V2 API; it makes no claim about real products, offers, inventory, merchant activity, or performance.
classificationDefinitions.UNSCORABLE: The required gold evidence or API capability is absent, or an outcome cannot be isolated and faithfully scored without inventing/assuming facts.
